answer: Require every agent identity to be minted through a non-transferable credential earned by solving a sequential proof-of-work trail that cannot be parallelized: the work leaves a plume of verifiable checkpoints, each costing real compute time. A second identity from the same operator must redo the whole trail, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand trails. Identities that wander off and stay idle lose credential weight, while a pearl of earned reputation, accumulated only through attested useful work, gates access to paid tasks. Sybil scale becomes linear in real cost instead of free.
